name: How To Treat Others
overview: Scripture instructs believers to treat others with love, kindness, and forgiveness, reflecting the heart of Christ's command to love one another as He has loved us. We are called to act toward others as we desire they act toward us, embodying the Golden Rule in both Matthew and Luke. This includes showing compassion even to enemies without rejoicing in their downfall, and maintaining brotherly affection that honors others above ourselves, demonstrating the practical outworking of Christian love and grace.
